title: Norish — a self-hosted recipe app built for families who love to cook together  #github
description:
Norish — a self-hosted recipe app built for families who love to cook together. Import recipes from URLs, or let AI fill in the details when needed. It even supports video recipe imports from TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. 

https://github.com/norish-recipes/norish

#github #opensource
